summary: Add an optional S3 region, make protection markers conditional and unique, and record the creating policy in the backup manifest so catalog rebuild recovers it. API impact: changed contract.

guide.reason: Operators can set an S3 region, learn that provider upload refusals fail the run, and that rebuilt points keep their policy and are pruned.

api.reason: S3 repository source gains optional region; the backup manifest and backup-now request gain optional policy_id.

roadmap.reason: Applies owner decisions 6 and 7 and the BUG-0746 follow-up.

state.reason: The region is part of the master's repository record and the policy ID is stored in the manifest in the repository itself, so a fresh Controller and a rebuilt master recover both from Core.
state.record: pool backup repository record s3_source.region; recovery point manifest policy_id

verification.method: Focused Go tests against a fake S3 and an in-process SFTP server, filesystem marker test, rebuild-then-prune test, and web unit tests. No lab, real S3 provider or browser run.
verification.limits: The fake S3 is not evidence of a real provider's conditional-write behavior. A stalled protect that lands after a newer unprotect can still recreate the marker (the safe direction).
